call_llm: call LLMs for auxiliary tasks with automatic provider fallback on payment or connection errors
async_call_llm: call LLMs asynchronously for auxiliary tasks with automatic provider fallback on errors
resolve_provider_client: resolve and build a configured OpenAI-compatible client for a given provider and model
get_text_auxiliary_client: get a text-only auxiliary client with automatic provider detection and caching
get_async_text_auxiliary_client: get an async text-only auxiliary client with automatic provider detection and caching
